notablePrerequisites: You have Serra the Benevolent's emblem.An additional creature on the battlefield under any player's control.
description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, triggering itself, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to Coalhauler Swine and to you, which does not reduce your life total below 1 due to Serra the Benevolent's emblem.
Coalhauler Swine triggers, dealing an equal amount of damage to each player, which again does not reduce your life total below 1.
